newsitem.title: USA: CERBCO sees reduced Insituform results.
newsitem.headline: CERBCO sees reduced Insituform results.

text.p: CERBCO Inc, which holds a controlling interest in Insituform East Inc, said on Thursday it expected delays to several major products would significantly reduce Insituform's third quarter results.
Insituform, which rehabilitates sewers and pipelines without excavating them, would also have lower results for the fiscal year compared to last year, it said.
While CERBCO said project delays in January hurt Insituform's third quarter, order increases over the rest of the year would lead to an improvement in the fourth quarter.
"Overall, East's earnings for the 12 months ending June 30 are presently anticipated to be both positive and significant, but materially reduced as compared to the previous fiscal year," CERBCO said.
CERBCO is a parent holding company with controlling interests in Insituform and Capital Office Solutions.
CERBCO said it expected sales revenues and earnings results for Capital Office to remain favorable.
Capital Office is involved in copier and fax equipment sales, service and supplies.
